title: Prince William reacts as Princess Diana's namesake charity enters administration after 27 years
summary_full: Prince William has reacted after The Diana Award, the charity established in memory of Princess Diana, entered administration after 27 years. The organisation has recognised more than 50,000 young people for their contributions to society, with Prince William and Prince Harry both supporting its work.
